name: Error Handling | Watchdog
description: Runs by itself every 4 hours (when active). Not called by any workflow: a safety net for crashed or killed executions and critical workflows that went silent, which the error handler cannot see.

parameters.content:
# Error Handling — Watchdog

Called by: entry point — own Schedule Trigger (not part of the Main Error Handler's execution; deployed separately under the same `error-handling` project folder because it has its own independent trigger)
Trigger: Schedule Trigger, every 4 hours
Standalone-capable: Yes — this is its own standalone workflow, always runs on its own schedule
Purpose: a safety net ONLY for failures the normal error path cannot see (an execution killed or crashed, e.g. out of memory, or a critical workflow that went silent). Ordinary errors are handled by the Main Error Handler and never reach this workflow.

What it does, step by step:
1. Every 4 hours, checks the n8n API for crashed executions in the last 4 hours and sends a Telegram crash alert for each
2. In parallel, checks the critical-workflows list in 'Stale Workflow List' (empty by default) for how long since each one's last successful execution, and sends a Telegram stale-workflow alert if any has gone silent past its expected interval

Status: switched OFF until a very critical workflow needs it.
